artifact.addressee_quote: One source of truth your whole team and every coding agent can read, across every repo.

sum: Describes changes as ADDED / MODIFIED / REMOVED deltas, so the spec survives and grows.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (AGENTS.md, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format markdown: Markdown, which any editor already reads
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec, ctrl and data_residency: the entry does not execute code itself and keeps its state local, so there is no unattended reach for a control to bound
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Zed, Codex CLI, JetBrains (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: package.json (commander)
evidence.ic.error: a documented flag that gates or previews the action: docs/cli.md (--yes)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: docs-lab/start/installation.md (nix profile)
evidence.fx.byo: the entry does not call a model provider itself, so there is no provider for the operator to substitute
evidence.sf.stop: a stop path, and the state it leaves behind is described: src/telemetry/index.ts (AbortSignal); docs/cli.md (Ctrl-C)
evidence.sf.warn: the irreversible step is both warned about and gated: docs-lab/start/installation.md (> [!WARNING])
